title: Simplify Completed current output status table
summary: Removes redundant health/state presentation from the Completed output tables and keeps the Evidence cell focused on actionable text plus placement status.
reason: The Current Output Status table repeated healthy/consistent information in the State, Evidence, and Health columns. The operator only needs the placement status chip for normal current rows and actionable evidence text when a row needs review.
behavior_before: Completed output rows showed a green Healthy state chip, a non-actionable Consistent evidence line above the Current chip, and a Health column with the same healthy/consistent status.
behavior_after: Completed output rows omit the redundant State and Health columns; normal healthy evidence text is suppressed so the Current chip stands alone, while warnings and review signals still render as evidence text.
rollback_plan: Revert the Completed table renderer, Completed partial, CSS width updates, and focused table-rendering test changes, then rerun the targeted WebView tests.
notes:
WebView presentation-only change. No backend command route, settings persistence, media policy, queue, publish/drain, rename, source, scratch, output, FFmpeg, subtitle, or audio behavior is changed.
Implementation scope limited to Completed WebView table presentation and focused renderer coverage.
